latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Editor Generator — fast, no-cost video editing in the cloud.

- Instantly edits and exports 1080p MP4 videos from raw footage with simple text instructions.
- Automatic cloud backend setup with free 7-day tokens (no manual API keys required).
- Supports video, audio, and image uploads (MP4, MOV, MP3, PNG, and more).
- Common actions: upload, trim silences, add music, overlay text, fast export to MP4.
- Automatic credit checking and session handling; clear messages for errors or limits.
- Optimized for short video workflows — rapid edits, easy downloads, no timeline required.
